violation_type.title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect and Exploitation (26 TAC §747.207(4))
violation_type.short_title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect and Exploitation
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not report suspected abuse of a child in care. The primary caregiver noted serious concerns regarding bruises that were observed on a child in care and stated that she knew she was required to report the suspected abuse. This information was obtained through the course of the investigation.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregiver did not report suspected abuse of a child in care. The primary caregiver noted serious concerns regarding bruises that were observed on a child in care and stated that she knew she was required to report the suspected abuse. Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the director of the operation did not inform childcare licensing within 48 hours after the incident occurred that led to an investigation.
